description: Create once with an optional unique username (3–48 letters/digits/_/-); omit it to use the stable account ID. Immediately save the private API key and reuse it for every utility request. Read utility_account to resume; never create a fresh account for each task. 500-credit monthly balance top-up through December 2026; read pricing for current policy. No automatic billing or health registration.
